config.selection: Validation RMSE for regression; positive-class F1 for classification. No test selection.
config.feature_scope: Residential: new apartments, old apartments, detached/garden houses.
config.final_fit: Original residential training subset only; validation is not refitted.

data.notes: Original full-dataset group split retained. Final residential training median defines the final classification task.

limitations: Asking prices, not verified transaction prices.
No independent manual validation of extreme price labels.
Random grouped split does not establish future-period performance.
CV is a fixed-configuration stability check, not nested model selection.
